projects.name: Chest Tunic
projects.shortDescription: A leather reinterpretation of an Egyptian-inspired tunic, upgraded with real leather, metal armor pieces, and an added back plate.

projects.name: Chevron Tunic
projects.shortDescription: A developing leather tunic built around a chevron pattern, currently completed through its first paper mock-up.

projects.name: Cuisses
projects.shortDescription: Leather and metal cuisses based on a Prince Armory design, modified to connect with matching greaves below the knee.

projects.name: Dragon Chestplate
projects.shortDescription: A red, black, and gold multi-piece dragon chest and back plate based on a Prince Armory pattern, with a future recolor or metal remake planned.

projects.name: Leather Coat
projects.shortDescription: A custom black leather coat with red accents, reverse-engineered from an irreplaceable older coat and redesigned as a modular garment.

projects.name: Right Sholder Tunic
projects.shortDescription: A leather and metal reinterpretation of an Amazon tunic, replacing the original soft materials with armored components on the right side.

projects.name: Tasets
projects.shortDescription: A black, red, and gold set of leather tassets combining two Prince Armory pattern variants into one design.

projects.name: Themadhood leather wraped Braser
projects.shortDescription: My first leather project: a single-piece Themadhood-logo bracer wrapped with thick leather cord and designed to slip on without buckles or ties.

projects.name: conbat brasser
projects.shortDescription: A heavy black leather combat bracer reinforced with three metal plates and built with integrated storage for pens, throwing spikes, and throwing knives.

projects.name: defence bracer
projects.shortDescription: A simple black leather defensive bracer reinforced with three black metal plates.

projects.name: greaves
projects.shortDescription: Red, black, and gold leather greaves based on a Prince Armory pattern, with metal shin pieces and planned upgrades to the dye and metal coverage.
